title: If You Missed NVIDIA, Jensen Just Showed Us What's Even Bigger (3 Stocks to Buy Now)
creator: MarketBeat
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; captions readable
summary: MarketBeat hosts Luke Lango (InvestorPlace) on Nvidia's AI-safety push: after Dario Amodei's "slow down" post and Trump calling Jensen Huang on stage at the All-In Summit, Huang is backing self-regulation tools (evaluations, safety tests, peer review) — which Lango argues means MORE compute spending, not less, with AI safety potentially the big winning vertical of 2027. The key shift: from pre-training (GPUs) to inferencing, where networking and CPUs are the bottlenecks and the CPU becomes the orchestration layer. Three BUYs: MRVL (Marvell) — "the next trillion-dollar company" per Jensen, custom chips/networking/switches for the buildout, chart rebounding above the 200-day MA, top of his shopping list; ARM — "highest torque" CPU play launching its first AI CPU at exactly the right moment, basing after a pullback, "could double or triple from here"; LITE (Lumentum) — his preferred networking play on the copper-to-photonics/fiber upgrade cycle, consolidating at highs before a breakout, 50-70% upside if macro clears (bear note: 10-year at 5.3% and the Iran war are pressuring multiples). No stated price levels on any call. Side segments: Elon Musk vertically integrating AI (Optimus, cybercab, xAI, space data centers) with a hinted Tesla/SpaceX merger, and a theory that AI execs are front-running expected 2028 regulation. Caption garbles: "Marll/Marbell" (Marvell), "Momentum/Lumenum" (Lumentum), "Jensen Wong" (Huang).
